changed.was: The house does not give the casks of every parcel; the small Highland malt blend is finished in heavily toasted French oak.
changed.now: Refill hogsheads for the Caol Ila and Williamson parcels, by the house's published recipe; the small Highland malt blend lies in custom French oak casks of heavy toast.
changed.why: the house's product page lists every parcel with its cask: Caol Ila refill hogsheads at 46, 14, 3 and 1 per cent, Williamson refill hogsheads at 35, and the Highland malt blend in custom French oak casks of heavy toast

changed.was: The house remade the whisky in 2009 with French oak cask heads; the house remade it in 2009 with French oak heads
